page.layout: One column of names, set in lines with rules between the groups, centred on the page. Three marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first, third and fourth groups. Years in the right margin, beside each group. Printed page number at the head.

l.note: Civitas Gron. socii; in agro pacti sunt cum Utrico de commerciis & tusu[?] Amasi fl. Sed pacto plebs oppidana intercessit.
Conventio nova civitatis cum Davide episc. Ultr. de praefectura suburbana : item cum Houv erdaeis.
Foedus civitatis cum Upsteranis perpetuum, civitati honorificum.

page.notes: The printed numbers 1457 to 1463 stand in the right margin, one beside each group of names, and are entered as notes. The left-margin notes are placed beside the groups they stand against. The word after "&" in the first left note is hard to read; it is marked [?]. The gap in "Houv erdaeis" is as printed. The rule lines between the groups are not text. The page number 28 is read from the top of the page and may be slightly blurred.
